sources.title: Carakasaṃhitā of Agniveśa, redacted by Caraka and completed by Dṛḍhabala (complete mūla text)
sources.source: Composite of three e-texts of the vulgate (Trikamji Acharya) text: (1) Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, CoNLL-U dump, commit 8aeed5a134 - Sūtra, Nidāna, Vimāna, Śārīra, Indriya and Cikitsā 1-5; (2) Maharishi International University 'Vedic Reserve' Charaka Saṃhitā pages - Cikitsā 6-30 and verses missing in DCS; (3) Sanskrit Wikisource (sa.wikisource.org) - Kalpa and Siddhi.
sources.license_note: The Sanskrit work is in the public domain. Per-verse `source` field shows provenance. DCS verses (4183): CC BY 4.0, attribution required - 'Oliver Hellwig: The Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), 2010-2024'. Wikisource verses (1077): Wikisource text is offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribute sa.wikisource.org contributors; share-alike applies to that portion). Vedic Reserve verses (4284): Maharishi International University's Vedic Literature Collection publishes no reuse licence - treat as REFERENCE ONLY until permission is obtained from MIU or the text is re-keyed/verified from a public-domain printed edition (e.g. Trikamji 1941).
